budget.purpose: Banksia Hall and Paperbark Quiet Room venue booking, including setup/pack-down window and seating/wayfinding access
Version-1 covered courtyard add-on for an art/observation activity
Two art/observation pack-sets, covering potential participation by 80 people at 40 people per set
Quiet-room sensory support kit for up to 20 people at a time
Non-alcoholic drinks and labeled simple snacks for up to 80 adults

in_kind_coverage.assumption: The fictional plan assumes donated coverage: one lead facilitator for 3 hours, two science speakers for 1.5 hours each, two arrival/wayfinding stewards for 3 hours each, and one quiet-room host for 2 hours (14 volunteer-hours total). This is not a commitment or availability confirmation.

assumptions: All budget amounts are fictional source-card base prices in integer AUD cents and include modeled taxes and fees; no additional prices are estimated.
The plan selects both venue cards for brief version 1; SRC-VEN-02 is expressly version-1-only and is subject to the predeclared closure in CH-001.

The full 80-person potential art participation is budgeted as two 40-person pack-sets. The courtyard capacity is 40, so no more than 40 participants may be assigned there at once; the programme must schedule a split/rotation or otherwise use rooms within stated capacities.
The venue card provides seating access for 80 and the included chair inventory (SRC-RES-01) is assumed available at no extra charge; no separate cash cost is assigned.
One quiet kit covers the stated maximum quiet-room capacity of 20 at a time; room use and transitions still require programme and floor-plan confirmation.
The 10% contingency is applied to total base cost and rounded up to the nearest cent; these source amounts yield an exact 51500 cents.

alternatives.option: Keep the version-1 courtyard activity as costed
alternatives.tradeoff: Supports an outdoor observation setting but creates a 40-person room limit and a later relocation requirement under CH-001.

alternatives.option: Do not select the courtyard add-on; plan the activity in Banksia Hall within its 80-person capacity
alternatives.tradeoff: Saves 30000 base cents and 33000 cents including associated contingency, while foregoing the courtyard setting. This alternative is not the selected v1 plan and requires programme/location consistency.

pending_human_decisions: Confirm whether fictional donated volunteer coverage is an acceptable planning assumption; no actual volunteer availability is established.
Confirm activity rotation, facilitator coverage, transition time, and maximum courtyard attendance of 40 in the v1 programme.

Confirm venue, suppliers, inventory, accessibility layout, food labeling/service details, and all availability with responsible humans before any real-world use; no legal or access clearance is asserted.
After CH-001, reselect venue resources for version 2 and preserve the ceiling and access requirements.
dependency_requests: Provide the matching-version creative programme for resource and capacity cross-check.
Provide matching-version risk review of transitions, volunteer coverage and room limits.

assumptions: Budget is an auditable fictional v1 plan using source-exact prices only.
Courtyard capacity constrains simultaneous use to 40; 80 potential art participants require split/rotation if all participate.
